description: This file implements the Grok LLM service, providing an interface to Grok's API compatible with OpenAI's API, including token usage tracking and context aggregation. It defines classes for managing context aggregators and the main service class that handles token metrics and client creation.

classes.name: GrokContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: A deprecated container class holding user and assistant context aggregators for Grok LLM interactions.

classes.name: GrokLLMService
classes.description: A service class extending OpenAILLMService to interact with Grok's API, including token usage tracking and context aggregator creation.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user context aggregator instance.

methods.name: assistant
methods.description: Returns the assistant context aggregator instance.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GrokLLMService with API key, base URL, and model.

methods.name: create_client
methods.description: Creates a Grok API client with specified API key and base URL.

methods.name: _process_context
methods.description: Processes a context and accumulates token usage metrics, reporting totals at the end.

methods.name: start_llm_usage_metrics
methods.description: Accumulates token usage metrics during processing, final totals reported after processing.

methods.name: create_context_aggregator
methods.description: Creates a GrokContextAggregatorPair from an OpenAILLMContext, with deprecation notice.
